# PR63 final portable evidence and metadata quality audit

Verdict: **PASS within the reviewed implementation, source, and evidence scope**. There are no blocking findings. Final metadata commit, ordinary dependency merge, conflict/main/ref guards, and protected push remain Root operations.

I performed a read-only independent audit of source `4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee`, tree `9659baeb98fcf7111435169eb04490ba3952989d`, in `/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy`. I did not run Cargo, a compiler, Gradle, the SDK, or the app, and did not mutate source, caches, Git state, original receipts, fixtures, or raw logs. The checks below inspect completed actual executions; they are not reviewer reruns. Only new audit scripts and reports were written externally.

All 4, 730 source paths match their exact recorded hashes under the unchanged seven exclusions, including 103 nested source-visible port evidence paths. All 4,725 preceding P1 source paths remain byte-identical except the single added `pub mod parallel_sync;` export. The five new policy/test/fixture/attribution files match the reviewed owner source. The complete original fixture preserves the nine assertions, their order and labels, both signed minimum model-version components, the empty description, and the ignored null consumer. All ten original owner static/runtime review texts remain byte-exact and return scoped PASS verdicts.

The new manifest binds **215 payloads, 28,112,051 bytes**, SHA-256 `395177461b4004bed9f89cf6e4835eafc4b46f60aa9193727cd0fefe013847e6`. Every payload hash and size passed. I independently compared 140 copies with their original bytes, decoded 56 UTF-8 and 18 base64 wrappers back to their exact originals, and reconciled the one generated summary against the actual gate receipts. The existing owner 45 and exact 133 packages and manifests remain unchanged. Raw ANSI/BOM/newline content, historical pending reports, failure evidence, original API/source fixtures, and supplemental test counts are preserved.

Canonical parity is 95 selected cases: 20 ported, 16 adapted, 59 unported, 36 passing, zero failing and zero not applicable. The old 35 statuses, reasons, target selection and command mappings are unchanged; only the already-selected parallel-sync method gains one original-case credit. Each of the 36 current source-bound exact logs records one actual passing test. The nine supplemental policy tests do not add original-test credit. Global discovery and mirror coverage remain incomplete.

The completed component proofs bind 261 tooling tests, 125 UI tests with one unchanged baseline ignore, a fresh normal library, repository Clippy and Cargo formatting. The independent normal full-app/link audit binds the actual 623.5448-second build and ELF SHA-256 `eac18f9a4c2ed6499406ba79b38a1ea6c290c903f7faa9c47472855aa3211e34`; its actual final linker changes only the output argument. CI run 37703317253 passed all three jobs. I independently parsed its exact 430,953-byte raw Linux log: **10,510 passed, zero failed, 23 existing skips in 1542.726 seconds**. The retained GitHub synthetic commit `8b4f48cbe5905baef4610a4d52732bf152e565bc` has the exact tested source tree and includes Source 4fb as a parent.

I rehashed all **677 native artifacts, 54,689,888 bytes**, preserving manifest SHA-256 `ca258cdf7b9a4f802daece0955e8877dccfe568877e854bc3404155843b957cb`. All 51 command starts/finishes match source, label, argv and exit zero. Both current complete models match the retained current Rust decoder output. I independently compared both preceding 905 full models and all seven older complete legacy projections, changing only each exact known private-root prefix. The legacy comparison excludes only the additive generated-artifacts envelope; all other nested values and list orders remain intact. All 17 screenshot hashes and Root's three visual-inspection bindings remain exact. The 12 fixture byte pairs and preserved original official wrapper match their recorded hashes; all three owned PIDs and X119 are absent. No unrelated process was signaled.

The packaging schema reconciliation preserves the 51-command checks under the real field name and both preceding 905 full-model checks, adds all seven legacy comparisons, and binds the actual three-PID cleanup list to the captured app PID. The 4730-source/12-fixture cleanup checks remain. Manifest provenance, both current Rust policy assertions and visual receipt guards are added. No assertion was deleted or weakened.

The final task report, PR body, port summary and stable owner handoff agree with these facts. Targeted report/body/port Prettier checks pass and formatting preserves the port JSON values. The normal repository Prettier command exited1, honestly retained: its 207 warnings comprise 133 unchanged tracked audit payloads, 73 byte-preserved new audit archives, and one mutable port before scoped formatting. The deliberately invalid negative fixture remains byte-identical and causes its existing parser error. The broad formatter is not claimed to pass and no original evidence was reformatted to appease it.

Scope limits remain explicit: the policy evaluates eligibility and does not schedule parallel Gradle work; the supplementary SDK driver is not the pinned reference driver; native execution adds zero original-case credit. The 230-pixel stress window is below the360-pixel supported minimum and only exercises tab overflow; the first trust-prompt screenshot receives zero loading credit, and no current SDK-error state is credited. The 677-file native manifest identifies retained external artifacts, while the portable package contains the declared subset and reversible images. No logical-tree, Kotlin facet, Rust LSP, hardware performance, phase 1 or full-IDE completion is claimed. The separate P2 source/test work is outside this audit.

The companion JSON binds the current calculation files and final owner handoff. Root may proceed with the already-authorized ordinary metadata commit and task/protected integration after its final guards.
